q1_issues.issue: (Past sk_win_2) tenses a gerund - "by winning the ... lottery" is non-finite and carries no tense atom of its own.

q2_gaps: a means / method gerund adjunct "by V-ing" relating two events - Instrument is entity-only ("never a person", a tool/substance/conduit), and the connective list covers only causal, purposive, concessive and adversative heads, so (By <event> <event>) has no licence and also collides with the passive by-agent reading
notes: Names are handled correctly - the plural team name is a Name-only individual with no invented team or GroupOf atom, and James/NBA get no invented type atoms. "Thursday night" correctly composes a Weekday term with the day-part symbol, and the infinitival complement of "the right" is reified tenselessly under an entity-attached To.
